entities.summary: Vincent Curry is an American former professional football player who was a defensive end for 11 seasons in the National Football League (NFL). After playing college football for the Marshall Thundering Herd, he was selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the second round of the 2012 NFL draft, with whom he won Super Bowl LII.
